5: export function getSeasonStatus(
6: 	season: Season
7: ): "active" | "upcoming" | "ended" | "locked" | "archived" {
8: 	if (season.archived) return "archived";
9: 	if (season.closed) return "locked";
10: 
11: 	const now = new Date();
12: 	const startDate = new Date(season.startDate);
13: 	const endDate = season.endDate ? new Date(season.endDate) : null;
14: 
15: 	if (startDate > now) return "upcoming";
16: 	if (endDate && endDate < now) return "ended";
17: 	return "active";
18: }
19: 
20: export function formatDate(date: Date) {
21: 	return new Date(date).toLocaleDateString("en-US", {
22: 		year: "numeric",
23: 		month: "short",
